title: AI ProposalContract (design-studio.proposal/1)
description: DEPRECATED and display-only. Version 1 is retained so historical proposals can be rendered, but it is never eligible for mutation because it has no document revision, typed operation, stable target, evidence binding, or trusted gate results. New CAD corrections use design-studio.proposal/2.

payload.description: typed per kind (e.g. geometry = a parametric program; footprint = a component/2 object; route = a track set). Validated against the kind-specific validator.

must_pass.description: the deterministic gates this proposal must clear before commit.
